story: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel RPG character sprite sheet on real transparent alpha. Create EXACTLY TWELVE separate full-body sprites in a STRICT 3-column, 4-row grid with generous transparent gutters, no labels and no ground/shadow. Input image1 is Eileen's authoritative portrait identity, image2 is only her original story-walk choreography. Match the portrait: the SAME sixteen-year-old navigation apprentice, soft youthful face, amber eyes, deep auburn RED wavy bangs with a long LOOSE LOW BRAID, never a high ponytail, never black/blue hair. Hair must be a SINGLE MATTE deep red fill #9e4247 with dark outline and braid dividing lines, no hair highlights. Two outfits of this same girl: TOP TWO ROWS are BASE traveler: high-collared muted magenta tunic, dark indigo leggings, short ivory SEA CLOAK, tiny brass compass clasp, chart-case strap, practical boots, all modestly covered. BOTTOM TWO ROWS are her independent ADVANCED Light Guide swordswoman outfit: structured ivory split travel-coat with full ivory shoulder mantle, indigo fitted underlayer and leggings, restrained magenta lining and brass clasp/trim, more capable heroic silhouette, no crown, no age increase. Advanced outfit must visibly differ in tailoring and silhouette, not just recolor. POSE ORDER in EACH six-sprite group, left to right top to bottom: FRONT walking left foot forward; FRONT opposite foot forward; BACK walking phase A; BACK opposite phase B; RIGHT SIDE walking phase A; RIGHT SIDE phase B. Both hands free beside body in all story sprites; no sword held, no magic, no props blocking feet. Fixed head height, fixed torso origin and scale in each two-phase pair, only two legs alternate forward/back, no horizontal leg flaring, clearly two feet. Keep both arms close to the torso, no exaggerated swing. Crisp restrained hand-crafted pixel art matching existing tactical RPG sprites, approx 48-64px character height before nearest-neighbor upscale, minimal 8-color flat matte palette: dark navy #172638, muted blue #3976b5, ivory #e4e1c8, skin #dda77d, muted magenta #89516d, braid red #9e4247, brass #bd9d68, pale blue #a7d7e5. No gradients, no glossy clothes, no glows, no sparkles, no drawn interface. Every sprite complete from hair to boots and isolated in its own equal cell. Compose large high-resolution sheet, 1200x1600 approximately.
